hourly.summary: Arsenal fans are absolutely fuming after a humiliating Carabao Cup struggle against League Two Fleetwood Town, with the Gunners held to a 1-1 draw, reduced to ten men after 16-year-old Max Dowman saw red, and facing a penalty shootout. The performance sparked familiar meltdowns — Havertz's finishing, Arteta's management, and the sheer embarrassment of nearly crashing out to lower-league opposition had the fanbase in full crisis mode.

daily.summary: The day began with strong optimism around injury returns, cup progress, and title race momentum, but sentiment dipped by evening as pride in Saka's Socrates Award was offset by fury over Raya's Yashin Trophy snub — a classic Arsenal swing from on-pitch hope to off-pitch grievance.

weekly.summary: Arsenal fan sentiment traced a sharp V-shape across the week: starting defiant but quickly descending into anxious guardedness after a Champions League draw at Bayern and Bukayo Saka's long-term injury confirmation, before rocketing to buoyant euphoria following a routine win over Everton and simultaneous slips from title rivals. The mid-week panic over Saka's absence and transfer frustration gave way to a weekend surge of title-race belief, Ben White praise, and schadenfreude, leaving the fanbase convinced a genuine charge is underway despite the looming Anfield test.
